rv.q: It’s an enjoyable production, with a healing dramatic crescendo and a medley of hits.
It’s a classic story that has been given the opportunity to be reawakened in a new production that keeps the essence of the story loved by many even 40 years after its original telling.

Finding themselves a magnet for trouble, Ren finds himself at the centre of a battle between generations looking for an outlet and an opportunity to express themselves within the safety of their own town.

cn.t: This energetic production celebrates the film's 40th anniversary with rambunctious spirit and bright ensemble dancing, delivering a hit-filled crowd-pleaser that captures the show's authority-bucking energy.
